This is lsu’s worst start to a season in four years. In brian kelly’s four-year tenure, he lost four games when favored by 3 or more points and lane has already lost two games when favored by 3+ points in his first six games! Karma can be so much fun.&nbsp;</p><p>Football is a funny thing – you go into a game fairly certain you know what the outcome will be.
